> A premium Israeli tax advisory practice led by a dual-qualified lawyer and CPA with an LLM degree and 12 years of experience, including 7 years at the Israel Tax Authority (serving large enterprises and the professional division). The brand projects authority, precision, and exclusivity — targeting sophisticated B2B clients such as accountants, lawyers, and CFOs who need expert opinions on complex tax issues including residency, control & management, financing expense offsets, structural reorganizations, advance tax rulings (pre-ruling), and transaction advisory. The tone is professional, trustworthy, and premium — a 'lawyer's lawyer' and 'accountant's accountant' positioning.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About חי עמוס, עורך דין ורואה חשבון
A premium Israeli tax advisory practice led by a dual-qualified lawyer and CPA with an LLM degree and 12 years of experience, including 7 years at the Israel Tax Authority (serving large enterprises and the professional division). The brand projects authority, precision, and exclusivity — targeting sophisticated B2B clients such as accountants, lawyers, and CFOs who need expert opinions on complex tax issues including residency, control & management, financing expense offsets, structural reorganizations, advance tax rulings (pre-ruling), and transaction advisory. The tone is professional, trustworthy, and premium — a 'lawyer's lawyer' and 'accountant's accountant' positioning.

## Target Audience
- רואי חשבון, עורכי דין ללא מחלקת מיסים, סמנכ"לי כספים ודירקטורים
- רואי חשבון ללא מחלקת מיסים
- סמנכ"לי כספים ודירקטורים
- עורכי דין ללא מחלקת מיסים

## Industry
Legal & Tax Advisory
